svg.text: BprFvgEA v11 - your rule: the BODIES of T1 / T2 and of C1 / C2 must not close out of the BPR box (synthetic bars; MQL5 detector records, REVERSAL, v11 defaults)
BPR tapped from ABOVE (bullish BPR): each body (open and close) must stay in the box or above it. The WICKS may go out. A body below the box -> NO TRADE.
BPR tapped from BELOW (bearish BPR): the mirror image - each body must stay in the box or below it. On the edge of the box counts as in the box.
1. VALID: the bodies stay in the box -> trade
T1 (17): its WICK goes below the box (allowed), its BODY closes in it (98.20).
C1 (18) closes in the box, C2 (19) above it: the rejection. Then 2 closes below the T1 wick: limits.
T1 wick 97.50: below the box, allowed
TRADE: limits from 23, moved at each new low
2. NO TRADE: the T1 body closes below the box
Your 'T1 NO': T1 (17) opens above the box and closes BELOW it (97.80 < 98.00).
v11 ends the setup on that close (DONE BROKEN). v10 traded it: limits on 23.
v10 would have placed limits on 23 (dimmed bars)
3. NO TRADE: C2 closes below the box
T1 (17): wick below the box, body in it: valid. C1 (18) in the box: valid.
C2 (20) opens and closes BELOW the box: no trade (DONE BROKEN on 20). v10 traded it (limits on 25).
v10 would have placed limits on 25 (dimmed bars)
4. Tap from BELOW (bearish BPR): the mirror image
The BPR is tested from below: the T1 / T2 bodies and the red C1 / C2 must stay in the box or below it.
Here T1 (17) closes ABOVE the box: no trade (DONE BROKEN on 17).
